data.one_liner: Cross-platform Firestore type-safe reference and document wrapper.
data.what_it_does: Provides type-safe helper wrappers for Cloud Firestore references and documents. Allows writing organized code when interacting with Firestore across mobile and web platforms.
use_when: You want type-safe access wrappers for Cloud Firestore collections and documents.
You need cross-platform Firestore operations including web support.
avoid_when: You prefer using the official cloud_firestore package APIs directly without wrappers.
You are using a backend other than Firebase.
strengths: Enables type-safe Firestore document and collection handling.
weaknesses: Adds an abstraction layer over the official cloud_firestore SDK.
Limited documentation and examples outside basic references.
data.setup_notes: Requires firebase_core and cloud_firestore setup in your Flutter project.

alternatives.name: cloud_firestore
alternatives.why_pick_it: Official Flutter plugin for Cloud Firestore without additional wrapper layers.
